<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula (DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X) / 2) and the molecular formula C15H12O3Cl (C=15, H=12, N=0, X=1), the calculation yields a non‑integer value. In many contexts, halogens are treated as equivalent to hydrogen, and the simplified DBE expression DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1 is used, which gives an integer result. Applying this gives DBE = 15 - 12/2 + 0 + 1 = 10.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
